title: Virtual University of Pakistan - Course Code Master
source_note: Compiled for HM Nexora from official VU study-scheme/course-catalogue/OCW naming available in indexed VU sources. VU may add, rename, retire, or re-code courses. The public catalogue endpoint was intermittently unavailable during compilation, so this file should be treated as a comprehensive working master rather than an archival guarantee of every historical course ever offered.
attendance_note: VU academic rules state that courses offered asynchronously have system-generated attendance activity and require participation in at least 50% of such activity. Practical/conventional courses can have separate attendance requirements. This file therefore does not infer attendance solely from a P suffix.

attendance.basis: LMS/system activity where course is offered asynchronously
attendance.note: VU academic rules require participation in system-generated attendance activity for asynchronous courses; exact implementation can vary by course/semester.
